marks.gloss_en: אלא: כאן שחסרה קודם קבלה, כאן שחסרה לאחר קבלה (= p_okimta_kodem_kabbala, p_okimta_achar_kabbala; its attack at 39b.2 is answered at 39b.4)
ולאחר שחיטה קודם קבלה מי שרי? והאמר רבי זירא אמר רב: הצורם אוזן הפר ואחר כך קיבל דמו פסול -- a blemish after slaughter but before receiving still disqualifies. Unanswered: the stam turns to אלא
Rav: one who slits the ear of the bull and afterwards receives its blood -- [the offering is] invalid
הכי נמי מסתברא, דתניא: רבי יהושע אומר ... זורק את הדם, שמע מינה -- even when most of the offering is gone after receiving, the blood is sprinkled, so completeness is not required at sprinkling
תרגמה אבן שנה -- the 'all its stages' clause is about being in its year only, not about being complete (= p_targema_aben_shana)
interpret it [the baraita's 'all its stages'] as about being in its year [only]
זאת אומרת -- the baraita, read as requiring the animal to be in its year at every stage, implies the year can end between them: hours disqualify
ומי איכא מידי דבשעת שחיטה הוי בן שנה ובשעת קבלה והולכה הוי בן שתי שנים? -- can an animal be in its year at slaughter and in its second year at receiving?
זאת אומרת שעות פוסלות בקדשים -- yes: age is reckoned by the hour, so the year can end between slaughter and receiving (= p_rava_shaot_poslot)
Rava: that is to say, hours disqualify in consecrated offerings
ולאחר קבלה קודם זריקה מי שרי? והתניא: שה תמים ... יהיה -- all its stages, receiving, conveying and sprinkling, must be complete and in its year
'a complete lamb, a male in its year, shall it be for you' (Ex 12:5) -- complete and in its year at the time of slaughter
בביצים ולא בגיד? -- in the testicles and not in the gid?
אימא: אף בביצים -- read 'also in the testicles' (= p_ry_af_babeitzim)
read: also in the testicles -- the words of R' Yehuda
and from where in receiving, conveying and sprinkling? 'shall it be' -- that all its stages be complete and in its year
the baraita as cited: 'bruised, crushed, torn, cut' (Lev 22:24) -- all of them in the testicles, the words of R' Yehuda
(proposed) do they not dispute this: one master holds an internal lack is a lack, the other that it is not?
on that hinge R' Yosei's split ruling fits neither side: if an internal lack is a lack, torn and cut too [would be blemishes]; if not, not even bruised and crushed
rather, here they dispute over visible blemishes
R' Yosei's reason for bruised and crushed being a blemish: they are not there
דתניא: ... ושליש שבית הלל אומרים אחד מארבע בטפח של כל אדם (kind tanya_kevatei for a bare דתניא, under protest)
the mishna (cited): [if] the tail was damaged from the bone, etc. [is a blemish]
דתנן: שתי אמות היו בשושן הבירה... נמצאת יתירה על של משה אצבע (kind tanya_kevatei for a bare דתנן, under protest)
Rav Huna son of R' Yehoshua: [it is said] for the two cubits
and how much should be hanging? Beit Shammai: four
the pouch (zoven) that was damaged [is a blemish]
תניא נמי הכי: נפגם ולא ניטל
תניא נמי הכי: כיס ולא זכרות
R' Elazar: [the mishna's case is where the pouch was] damaged, and not removed
